- **Entry fees:** $35 for the first entry and $25 for later ones at the Mohawk River trials, $35 and $30 at the Albany trials.
- **Breeds:** All AKC-recognized breeds and All-American dogs are eligible.
- **Pended:** The four Mohawk River trials are still "Pended", which means AKC hasn't finalized them.
- **Search settings:** I searched the Companion Events "Obedience (O/SO/PO/LO)" category with the state set to NY and event dates 05/01/2027–05/31/2027.
- **Cookie banner:** The banner on the event-search site only offered "Accept All Cookies", so I left it alone.

The results page is open in the browser if you want the premium lists or full event details.
